snippet.title: Topdeck Automat - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4321920/Topdeck_Automat/

Topdeck Automat is the roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! You are a brave printer robot, hacked and reprogrammed to fend off the alien invasion. Hundreds of cards, free-form upgrades, infinitely stackable modules, broken builds!
